sentence: Tested locally: on 300 LongMemEval conversational-memory questions, BM25 scored 191/300 (63.7%; 95% interval 58.1 to 68.9) versus dense retrieval's 165/300 (55.0%; 95% interval 49.3 to 60.5), an 8.7-point difference (95% interval 2.7 to 14.7; exact p = 0.006), using MiniLM and one small local Gemma 2 9B reader. BM25 was strong on single-session facts and knowledge updates but weak on multi-session reasoning and preferences; this supports keeping a keyword leg and measuring on your own questions, not general superiority, with the harness in the companion repository under benchmarks/longmemeval.
